eligibility.evidence: E2 fails (p.1-3, Sec 2-3): ChatGPT-4o gets eight hand-written conversation vignettes (ethics, commonsense, cultural advice), coded qualitatively against Grice's maxims; no cognitive-experimental paradigm cited or named, 'Turing test' is only a label. Borderline: body-movement and sun-orientation prompts are commonsense reasoning.

A.title: Limits of ChatGPT's conversational pragmatics in a Turing test on ethics, commonsense, and cultural sensitivity

G.notes: Single-rater-pair qualitative coding of one ChatGPT-4o conversation per topic; no model version string, date, temperature or repeats; no human data. Referee would ask why this counts as a Turing test and for inter-rater agreement. Transcript on Zenodo 14762324.
